leadText:
Mt. Molteau (Japanese: アルドル山 Mt. Ardres) is an -exclusive location in Kalos that was featured in A Legendary Photo Op!. The active volcano is located between Dendemille Town and Anistar City.

While passing by, and encountered their old friend at Mt. Molteau. Trevor was keen to get a photo of , having already taken a picture of the other legendary birds, and . Using 's Rock Searcher Mark 1, the group searched for Moltres, which later malfunctioned after being kicked by Jessie. 

Trevor and the group arrived at the top of Mt. Molteau, only to discover that had followed them. A battle ensued, but was disrupted by Moltres as it emerged from the volcano. The Legendary Pokémon easily blasted off Team Rocket with . Moltres then turned its attention to the group. Ash's Fletchinder and Trevor's Charmeleon took on Moltres. however Moltres proved too powerful. Fletchinder eventually evolved into and learned . Despite evolving, Talonflame was overpowered by Moltres's and was falling without senses into the volcano. Ash jumped to save it and 's frubbles helped them back up. Moltres flew away after understanding that Ash and his friends weren't enemies.

The group left Mt. Molteau, with Trevor revealing that he was able to get a picture of Moltres.
